product.summary: Shift scheduling and time tracking for restaurants and cafés.

source.quote: Shiftwise sells shift scheduling and time tracking to restaurants and cafés.

evidence.value: Four years old; 380 business customers; about 45,000 staff use it each month

source.quote: We are four years old, with 380 business customers and about 45,000 staff who use the app each month.

evidence.value: ARR passed $3.1M, growing about 60% a year for two years

source.quote: Annual recurring revenue passed $3.1M last quarter and has grown about 60% a year for two years.
Engineering is 14 people in three teams
380 business customers
about 45,000 staff who use the app each month

observed.what: API requests on a normal weekday

source.quote: Around 2.5 million API requests on a normal weekday.
The main Postgres database is 900 GB
grows about 25 GB a month

peaks.what: request rate while managers publish rotas, Sunday 6pm to 9pm

source.quote: managers publish next week's rota between 6pm and 9pm, and request rates reach about 8 times the weekday average for those three hours
Clock-ins cluster at the start of shifts, especially 6-7am and 4-5pm local time.

availability.value: 99.9% monthly uptime for clock-in, promised in the largest customers' contracts, with service credits

source.quote: Their contracts promise 99.9% monthly uptime for clock-in and give them service credits when we miss it.

data_loss_tolerance.value: No confirmed clock-in may be lost; the rota can be rebuilt from its last published version and an hour of draft edits may be lost

source.quote: losing a confirmed clock-in is not acceptable: it means someone may be paid wrongly. The rota itself can be rebuilt from the last published version if we must, and an hour of lost draft edits would be annoying but tolerable

data_categories.value: staff names, phone numbers, emails, availability, hours worked and pay rates

source.quote: We hold staff names, phone numbers, emails, availability, hours worked and pay rates.
Location is recorded at clock-in only, to show the employee is on site

source.why: Employee records with pay rates and a location at clock-in: harmful if leaked, but no health, card or government-id data and no continuous tracking.

jurisdictions_or_rules.value: EU customers' data must stay in the EU under data processing agreements

source.quote: About a third of our customers are in Germany, France and the Netherlands, and their data must stay in the EU under our data processing agreements with them.

jurisdictions_or_rules.value: no tracking between clock-ins, promised to works councils

source.quote: we do not track people between clock-ins and we promised customers' works councils that we never will

requirements.value: single sign-on through customers' own identity providers

source.quote: Several chains want single sign-on through their own identity providers.

unknowns.question: How many of the 40 prospects in the sales pipeline will need EU hosting?
unknowns.why_it_matters: It decides how much capacity and operations the EU region needs.

unknowns.question: What will the SOC 2 auditors ask us to change?
unknowns.why_it_matters: The audit may require controls that change access, logging and deployment; the renewals depend on it.

unknowns.question: What budget is there for the platform work?
unknowns.why_it_matters: The brief gives running costs but no money for building; it bounds how much can change in 18 months.
